title: Brutal Drinks Brutal Bull 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Brutal Bull Shortfill e-liquid delivers the fresh, fruity, fizzy flavour of your favourite sports drink. With its sweet and tangy notes, this e-liquid is perfect for vapers seeking a flavourful yet light and refreshing experience inspired by popular beverages. Designed by the mixologists at Just Juice, Brutal Drinks Shortfills combine intense flavours with a high-VG formula, making them ideal for sub-ohm devices and advanced kits. Each 100ml bottle leaves space for two nicotine shots, offering vapers the flexibility to adjust their nicotine strength. Part of the Brutal Drinks collection, Brutal Bull joins a range of exciting drink-inspired blends, including Pina Colada, Mango Lassi, and Frozen Mojito. Explore the full range for more bold and versatile e-liquid options.
